cosmology.EOS_interpolation: PCHIP in logT/logg; entropy-conserved a(T); early time integral dln(a)/H_SM; late LCDM including matter and Lambda

scope: Early NR parents, fixed pole masses, constant local widths, exponential decay and collisionless chi propagation. Gauge-only widths are computed inputs; every chi abundance/branch is conditional on soft not-yet-on-shell matching. Normalization packets are distinct finite stages, not a completed common history.
non_claims: No thermal scattering, inverse decay, entropy injection or evolving-X width solution
No assertion that all radiation is visible or that unbroken model gauge bosons thermalize with SM
One-kpc criterion applies to this produced component; a tiny warm fraction is not an all-DM exclusion
